frontmatter.name: graphify
frontmatter.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

nodes.rationale: Vendored because Bionic statx from API 30 SIGSYS-kills legacy devices on raw syscall probe; weakcall returns ENOSYS to allow fstat64 fallback. Keep smoke test and verify both APK ABIs on upgrade.

nodes.label: Extension Driven Design Principle

nodes.rationale: Use scoped graphify query/path/explain subgraphs instead of raw grep because they are much smaller than full report or grep output.

nodes.label: Graphify Update Workflow
nodes.rationale: Run graphify update after modifying code to keep the AST-derived graph current at no API cost; dirty graph files after hooks are expected.

nodes.label: Strict Analyzer Configuration
nodes.rationale: Enforce strict casts, inference and raw types plus public API annotations and unreachable-from-main to catch dead cross-layer chains early.
